## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding from standard reviewer.
Finding: The enforcement-gate-contract.md 'Gating Hooks' section lists pre-commit-review-gate.sh, pre-commit-test-gate.sh, and pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh as already sourcing enforcement-gate.sh, but those hooks are not modified until S2. This creates a misleading contract doc.
File: plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate-contract.md
Category: design
Suggested fix: Add a note to the 'Gating Hooks' section stating these hooks will source the library after S2 implementation.
data.title: [enforcement-gate-contract.md]: Contract lists hooks as sourcing library before S2 implements it — add 'pending S2' note
